It opens in the tau2Airline system with read-only reviews: full details of reservation 385BB3 (JFK->MIA, Business, confirmed), the cancelled 88A8C4 (SEA->SFO, $489 fully refunded, zero fee), the complete customer profile, a JFK->MIA flight search, and a business-vs-economy fare comparison reusing already-fetched data. The user then requests a written record plus follow-up tasks; that step times out after 600 seconds (turn 6). The agent resumes in turn 7, rebuilding a Word document from scratch with python-docx after detecting that appends had duplicated sections, converting it to PDF, creating a calendar event for Ethan, emailing the summary to Priya, and updating the travel-expenses spreadsheet. One subtask is genuinely impossible — Olivia's inbox (and every other inbox) is empty, so there is no onboarding email to read — and the agent escalates it to a human agent with a precise summary. The outcome is recorded unresolved because that onboarding-email item is handed off rather than completed.
